description: The inputs of a colocation data-centre business case for one European market: construction cost per MW, colocation prices per kW-month, electricity price, staff cost, guarding, property tax, exit yield, grid wait, permitting and grid charges. Needs a personal ScienceShot key (Authorization: Bearer): a free account gets round example values, ScienceShot Premium the ScienceShot figures with low and high; each answer counts as one run. Markets: Amsterdam, Athens, Berlin, Copenhagen, Dublin, Frankfurt, Helsinki, Lisbon, London, Madrid, Milan, Oslo, Paris, Stockholm, Vienna, Warsaw, Zurich.
name: business_case_figures
title: Data-centre business-case figures for one market
